definitions.full: H3883. lul [ לוּל ] noun [masculine] shaft or enclosed space (possibly in wall), with steps or ladder, only plural לוּלִים 1Kin 6:8 יַעֲלוּׅ (וּבְלוּלִים , on meaning see Sta ZAW iii, 1883, 136 ff. > ᵑ9 ᵐ5 winding-stair , compare Buhl, see Sta l. c (Late Hebrew לוּל winding passage or stair , or enclosed space in which is a winding stair , according to Levy NHWB ii. 486 , but see Sta l.c .; √ dubious; hardly לולו below) לוּלֵי לוּלֵא, see below לוּ . לולו (apparently secondary √ from III. לוה turn, twist, wind , whence following).
